thread:
ravi: heads-up: customer in EU blocked on our async python quickstart for Dedicated. they mount a CA via k8s secret (inline PEM) and our client doesn't accept that.
tara: are they using REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE or a file mount?
ravi: inline via env REDWOOD_CA_INLINE='-----BEGIN CERTIFICATE-----
MIIC...
-----END CERTIFICATE-----'. client errors with CERTIFICATE_VERIFY_FAILED.
morgan: current impl only reads REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE path or verify=True/False. quick change: parse REDWOOD_CA_INLINE if present and write to a temp file, then build ssl.SSLContext from that. fallback order: explicit param > REDWOOD_CA_BUNDLE > REDWOOD_CA_INLINE > system.
tara: also add typing fix: stubs currently say verify: bool, should be Union[bool,str]. small but important for DX.
qa-bot: created ticket SDK-499 for inline-ca parsing and typing.
morgan: also found async retry policy retries POSTs on 502; causing duplicate inferences. propose default safe retries that skip non-idempotent methods and 401. add `retry_mode='safe'|'aggressive'` config.
ravi: +1. can we include a short troubleshooting hint when base_url looks like an IP and verify is set? saves customers from SNI mismatches.
tara: will add a runtime warn message and doc note in Dedicated onboarding.
morgan: opening draft PR with tests that simulate inline PEM and a local SAN cert. targeting patch release after review.
qa-bot: PR 2450 opened by morgan (draft) 94 tests running.
